## Summary

Describe the change and its purpose. Use a scoped conventional PR title, such as
`feat(projects): add a case study` or `fix(navigation): restore keyboard focus`.
Authored commit messages must be unscoped conventional messages, such as
`feat: add a case study`.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and actual results, including any limitations.
